explanation: The election was fought on what the impeachment left. Temer, who replaced Rousseff, broke sharply with her policies, amended the constitution to freeze public spending, reached an approval rating of 7 per cent against 76 per cent wanting him gone, and was himself ineligible to stand. A right-wing outsider won an election in which the party that had governed since 2002 could field neither its president nor its strongest candidate.
